resources.notes: Release adapter accepts 48,570 unique Devanagari forms after NFC, script, leading-letter, and context-valid joiner filtering.
Release adapter deduplicates 71,843 repeated prompt rows before log-scaled ranking, retains only context-valid conjunct joiners, and rejects malformed runs whole. The resulting pack is CC-BY-SA-4.0.

resources.format: ZIP of JSONL train, validation, and test transliteration pairs
resources.notes: Exact members are 2,397,414 train, 2,804 validation, and 4,101 test rows. The release adapter uses only 2,766 joined AK-Freq and 663 joined Wikidata training rows, excludes 47,466 joined IndicCorp rows because the card disclaims ownership of underlying extracted text, and never consumes validation/test rows as aliases. The whole archive therefore remains fail-closed even though the reviewed subset is notice-complete.

resources.format: Fairseq native-to-Roman transformer checkpoint and dictionaries
resources.notes: Used only on the remote build host to generate beam-4 lowercase ASCII aliases over the pinned direct-form vocabulary. The model is not bundled in Android and evaluation rows are not model inputs. Checkpoint SHA-256 is 45ffecef88d990ae12f915939b91267a3fc8f69f26331baa59f7932005976f28.

resources.format: MediaWiki pages/articles XML compressed with bzip2
resources.notes: Generator v2 pins the dump license notice, permanent Wikimedia Terms revision 554823, and CC BY-SA 4.0 legal code. It produced 439,308 unique Devanagari tokens from 42,263 articles and 8,949,123 token occurrences plus a complete per-article attribution index; two builds were byte-identical at vocabulary SHA-256 829c71836407912509883917a43c88d301f9be08c4400442b4a61d6eaf742214 and attribution SHA-256 fd5bd0744f6e2fcbc3e3d2465e6346394fe66af30c79bd625fc791707d302b7e. The keyboard notice/share-alike mechanism has not passed release review, so generated rows retain WIKIMEDIA_ATTRIBUTION_REVIEW_REQUIRED and cannot enter a shipping pack.

resources.format: ZIP containing Hunspell DIC/AFF and upstream README
resources.notes: The archive's upstream README identifies Nepali SpellChecking Dictionary 2.1 (2008-04-25), 36,827 declared entries, MPP contributors, and LGPL 2.1. Parsing yields 36,150 unique base surfaces; their union with the current direct pack adds 22,347 candidates but only 59 of 4,101 held-out targets. Shipping requires attribution, license text, modification notice, and corresponding-source compliance; this source is not used by the current release pack. Affix expansion is morphology evidence, not frequency evidence.
Six local tests pass; 518,373 folded lookup keys were observed in the audit.
